mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, F.FORM_NM, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, M.DRA_LEVEL_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, M.CURR_LINE_SEQ, M.CURR_APPROVER_ID, M.CURR_APPROVER_NM, CASE WHEN M.CURR_APPROVER_ID != #{userId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DELEGATED FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DOC_STATUS IN ('REQUEST', 'PROGRESS') AND ( M.CURR_APPROVER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM03M02 G WHERE G.ORIGIN_USER_ID = M.CURR_APPROVER_ID AND G.DELEGATE_USER_ID = #{userId} AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN G.START_DT AND G.END_DT ) ) ORDER BY M.DRAFT_DT ASC, M.DOC_ID ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
